How big are today’s deals?

Of 476 tracked routes, 47% are currently priced below their normal range. Among those, fares sit about 17% below typical on average, and 117 routes are 15% or more below normal — the genuine deals worth grabbing.

Methodology

Figures come from Magellan Flights’s live fare tracker, which checks the cheapest real, bookable round-trip and one-way fares from major US airports several times a day. “Normal price” is each route’s tracked baseline; a fare is “below normal” when it’s under that baseline. Prices are in USD and change constantly — this page reflects the most recent refresh on October 10, 2026.
